text: Entry Requirements 1.Applicants must be between 18 and 35 years old, hold a non-Chinese nationality, and meet the requirements of the Ministry of Education Document No. 12 [2020]. 2.Applicants should have good conduct, be in sound physical and mental health, and comply with Chinese laws and regulations as well as the rules and regulations of Tianjin Foreign Studies University. 3.Applicants for undergraduate programs must have a high school diploma. 4.For English-taught programs, applicants must achieve an IELTS score of 6.0 (or above) or a TOEFL score of 80 (or above) or an equivalent level of English proficiency.
